title: A Versatile Framework for Evaluating Ranked Lists in terms of Group Fairness and Relevance
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a framework for evaluating ranked lists based on group fairness and relevance, using attributes like income level, opinion polarity (pro/con), and commercial properties of businesses.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
